event_summary: A white crumpled piece moves downward inside a clear container and ends up resting on the green-topped blue liquid.
raw_event_description: At the start, a tall clear container stands on a wooden tabletop with blue liquid in its lower portion and a green horizontal layer at the liquid surface. A white crumpled piece is visible near the upper opening, close to blue supports. Later, the white piece is seen lower inside the container, continues downward through the open interior space, reaches the liquid-surface region, and remains there with part of it visible above the surface.

reasons: The transparent container and liquid level are clearly visible.
The white crumpled piece and blue supports near the top are partly cropped and partly obscured by the rim area.
